description: Returns your email and name, and the account's plan, usage and caps.
name: whoami

caps.description: What the account is allowed to hold, under usage's cap keys, so the pair divides. A pending invitation takes a member place, so it counts against members.

customDomains.description: Hostnames the customer owns, paused ones included.

deployments.description: Deployments, every row whatever its status.

members.description: Member places: as caps, how many people the plan allows, the owner included; as usage, the members the account has.

platformDomains.description: Names chosen under the platform's own suffix, e.g. "my-app.shipstatic.com".

name.description: Display name; null if not set.

plan.description: The plan the account is on. One of: free, pro, team, scale, sponsored.

usage.description: What the account currently holds: every cap, and the pending invitations beside them.

customDomains.description: Hostnames the customer owns, paused ones included.

deployments.description: Deployments, every row whatever its status.

invitations.description: Invitations still open: pending and not yet expired. Each takes a member place beside the members, against the members cap.

members.description: Member places: as caps, how many people the plan allows, the owner included; as usage, the members the account has.

platformDomains.description: Names chosen under the platform's own suffix, e.g. "my-app.shipstatic.com".
